description: Rule reference tables transcribed from the official core rulebook (PDF '© 2005, 2006', revised-edition rulebook). Every 'quote' is verified verbatim (whitespace-normalised) against the extracted page text by the official_docs parser.

monster_movement_types.quote: The color of the border indicates the monster’s movement type (Black – normal, Red – fast, Yellow – stationary, Blue – flying, Green – special).

rows.name: Ambush
rows.quote: Ambush: Once combat has begun with this creature, the investigator no longer has the option to flee it, but must instead fight until one or the other is defeated.

rows.name: Endless
rows.quote: Endless: A monster with this ability cannot be collected as a monster trophy. Instead, each time it is defeated, return it to the cup.

rows.name: Physical Resistance
rows.quote: Physical/Magical Resistance: A Weapon or Spell that adds a bonus of the resisted type can only provide half its normal bonus (rounded up).

rows.name: Magical Resistance
rows.quote: Physical/Magical Resistance: A Weapon or Spell that adds a bonus of the resisted type can only provide half its normal bonus (rounded up).

rows.name: Physical Immunity
rows.quote: Physical/Magical Immunity: A Weapon or Spell that adds a bonus of the resisted type provides none of its normal bonus.

rows.name: Magical Immunity
rows.quote: Physical/Magical Immunity: A Weapon or Spell that adds a bonus of the resisted type provides none of its normal bonus.

rows.name: Nightmarish X
rows.quote: Nightmarish X: Any investigator that passes a Horror check when facing this monster still loses X Sanity. This ability doesn’t apply if the investigator fails the Horror check.

rows.name: Overwhelming X
rows.quote: Overwhelming X: Any investigator that defeats this monster in combat still loses X Stamina. This ability doesn’t apply when the investigator fails his Combat check against the monster.

awakening_open_gates.quote: If too many gates are open at once, the Ancient One can immediately awaken.

monster_limit.note_quote: If the terror level reaches 10, Arkham is overrun, which means that the monster limit is removed for the rest of the game.

outskirts_limit.quote: When the number of monsters in the Outskirts of Arkham exceeds this limit, place all of those monsters back in the cup and raise the terror level by 1.

terror_level_events.quote: For every step the terror level increases, return one Ally at random from the Ally deck to the box.

rows.event: Arkham is overrun (no monster limit and add one doom token).

location_stability.quote: Locations with green diamonds are stable. Monsters and gates will never appear in these locations

board_structure.quote: The Arkham city section of the board shows the city of Arkham divided into 9 neighborhoods, each of which has between 2 and 3 important locations in it, as well as a street area (B).
board_structure.special_areas_quote: The City Limits section of the board contains three special areas: Outskirts (E), The Sky (F) and Lost in Time and Space (G).

special_card_limit.quote: In most cases, a player may never have more than one copy of each special card at the same time. This rule applies to Retainers, Bank Loans, Silver Twilight Memberships, and Bless/Curse cards.

victory_conditions.quote: The investigators win the game in any of the following three ways:

rows.name: A. Close the Gates
rows.quote: When the last gate is closed, the players must have a number of gate trophies equal to or greater than the number of players.

rows.name: B. Seal the Gates
rows.quote: If, at any time, there are six or more elder sign tokens on the board, the players immediately win.

rows.name: C. Banish the Ancient One
